purpose: Close the bounded z=0 prior question and deliver an actual-data preliminary density/velocity diagnosis; not another open-ended toy-model series.

data.contract: Reuse exactly saved native-PM density/velocity and synthetic observations. New field prior is trained only on 1-4. Truths 0 and 5 are previously inspected development fields. Observation machinery is shared, not independent galaxy validation. No truth initializer, post-hoc field smoothing or LCDM IC power change.

model.transform: Training-only pooled centered-log-density quantiles; monotone C1 cubic map with linear tails. Fit density/velocity covariance after inverse-transforming training density coordinates. Sample white coordinates, not a post-hoc map correction.
model.limits: A one-point transform plus Gaussian copula cannot certify nonlinear morphology, dynamics, scale transfer or IC realizability. Fixed finite-training covariance uncertainty is not marginalized.

assessment.comparison_rule: All six fits including reused controls must pass unchanged mechanics gates. Within EACH truth field, average the paired metrics over available gamma cases. Require support density RMSE reduction >=2%, correlation gain >=0.01, nonnegative heldout count LPPD gain, and no worsening >0.02 in absolute 68/95 coverage error. Every individual pair must avoid >2% density or velocity-component RMSE degradation. These are frozen engineering adequacy thresholds, not significance or calibration claims.
assessment.interpretation: Report velocity predictions, all density/velocity metrics and curvature intervals, not only histogram shape. Count LPPD comparisons are always paired on identical data. A failure ends this prior-repair comparison; no automatic retuning, new prior family or simulation. Driver chooses a model only for the next explicitly labelled actual-data diagnostic, or reports a model block.
assessment.next: After driver review, at most one actual-data four-chain fit within Bundle A; actual input semantics and model choice must first be recorded. No automatic submission by the comparison script. Bundle B requires user approval.
